args.summary: Fixed the ascii.qdp reader in astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py, which assumed QDP commands are upper case and crashed on hand-written files like "read serr 1 2" with "ValueError: Unrecognized QDP line". Root cause: _line_type compiled its line-classification regex (command "READ [TS]ERR", new-table "NO NO", data tokens) case-sensitively. Fix: compile the regex with flags=re.IGNORECASE so all QDP line types match regardless of case, and make the masked-value check in _get_tables_from_qdp_file case-insensitive (v.upper() == "NO") so lowercase "no" data values are masked rather than failing float() conversion. Also added a doctest documenting lowercase command acceptance. Verified with the exact reproduction from the PR description (now reads a table with col1, col1_err, col2, col2_err), edge cases (mixed-case commands, lowercase NO values, lowercase new-table marker, comma-delimited files via sep=',', gibberish still rejected), the existing test_qdp.py suite (8 passed), qdp.py module doctests (4 passed), and the full astropy/io/ascii/tests suite (825 passed, 36 skipped, 6 xfailed). Only the source file was modified; no test or config files were touched.
